passFindings: THE CROSS-REFERENCE RESOLVED: radiant_lance r3 'beats a Harmonic shield's FIRST RANK' and resonant_shield r3 'turns a Radiant lance's FIRST strike'. Authored adjacently, these now form a RANKED counter-pair — lance r3 beats shield r1; shield r3 turns lance r1. Neither is a flat hard-counter; who wins depends on which RANK each has reached. This is the strongest possible argument that §11 Gap-2 soak must be RANKED, and it is now expressible in content from both sides.

A THIRD cross-reference: resonant_anchor r3 holds against 'a Radiant lance's push', and shatterpoint r3 calls the shatterpoint of 'a Harmonic shield OR Radiant lattice'. The catalog is densely cross-referential — traditions were authored knowing each other. A composed/cross-tradition interaction mechanic would be reading intent that is already there.
shatterpoint r3 counters its OWN tradition's resonant_shield. The best answer to a harmonic is another harmonic — an authored intra-tradition counter worth preserving as mechanic.

A SECOND precursor hook: echo_memory r3 hears 'what a Precursor mechanism LAST SAID'. With radiant's prism_sight r3 (sees 'the seams of Precursor work'), TWO traditions independently give players a way to CONTACT precursor presence. SNG-261 §B's staging problem is largely already solved in content — it needs wiring, not authoring.

the_worldsong is the THIRD capstone (after the_last_light, light_borne) to demand REFUSED on both intensity modes and to be a KIND rather than a magnitude. Three traditions, three capstones, identical register — the T-IV/V pattern is now demonstrated, not asserted.

harmonic_voice's HARD bounds ('cannot change anyone's mind — only their temperature', 'cannot make anyone agree') are the tradition's ETHICAL spine: harmonic influence never becomes mind-control at any level of mastery. Bound-classing surfaced a values statement the mechanics must protect.

sonic_resonance's 'NOT LETHAL BY DESIGN — the field limits output near living tissue' is HARD and notable: it is a fact about the WORLD's field, not the wielder's skill. A whole damage-craft that can never kill. Worth Erik knowing the mechanic will hold that line.

STALE-PROSE CLASS FOUND (Erik's no-harm reversal): a craft's cannot-text can contradict its own harmRung. sonic_resonance says 'not lethal by design' while tagged harmRung:damaging with strike/break. A sweep found the same shape on `palework` (harmRung: lethal, text denies harm). This is a THIRD bug-class sibling to PromisedButUnread — call it ContradictedByItsOwnTag: content that argues with its own mechanical field. Worth a CI check: a craft whose cannot-text denies harm while its harmRung asserts it should be flagged for prose revision.
